title: Oh My codeX
list_summary_zh: OMX是Codex CLI的工作流增强工具，提供标准化指令和状态管理，适合macOS/Linux开发者。
feynman_summary:
OMX is a workflow enhancement layer for OpenAI Codex CLI, designed primarily for macOS/Linux environments. It extends Codex's capabilities through predefined role commands like `$deep-interview` for task clarification and `$ralplan` for implementation planning.

The system maintains project states in `.omx/` directory and recommends tmux for team coordination. Key features include launching optimized sessions with `--madmax --high` flags, standardized workflows, and persistent state tracking. Installation requires Node.js 20+ and Codex CLI, with core maintenance by Yeachan Heo and HaD0Yun.
